scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && node -e "const p=require(\"./package.json\"); const bad=Object.entries(p.dependencies||{}).filter(([,v])=>v.startsWith(\"file:\")); if(bad.length){console.error(\"ERROR: file: dependencies are not allowed in published packages:\",bad.map(([k,v])=>k+\"=\"+v).join(\", \")); process.exit(1)}"
